mentions.name: cuckoo-nest
mentions.description: A GitHub-hosted project that makes the Nest 2nd gen thermostat recently bricked by Google compatible with local setups like Home Assistant; cited as one of three projects solving the problem from different angles.
mentions.problem: Google recently bricked the Nest 2nd gen thermostat, leaving it incompatible with local setups like Home Assistant.
mentions.audience: Users of local smart home setups like Home Assistant
mentions.author: z3ugma
